turns.q: Do you need photos, and where do I send them?
turns.replyTail: Yes, clear images of the damage are needed for verification. If your order is within the 30-day return period, please submit a request through the Return Portal and select “Item was damaged.” You’ll be able to upload the images there, and the submission will be reviewed within 2–3 business days. If the order is outside the return period, or the item is Final Sale or otherwise non-returnable, please include your order number, item name, and clear images of the damage when requesting a resolution.
